mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 5-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A lower unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates stronger labor market conditions that support corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for UNRATE as a predictor of 60-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1150.0 thousand units signals weakening residential demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1150.0.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) below 107.0 indicates manufacturing weakness that reduces corporate profits, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 107.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust economic expansion that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (PAYEMS * RSAFS) has Rank IC below 0.03 for 20-day SPX returns over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a 25 basis point increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) within a month predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp during a monetary tightening cycle.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), a decline in unemployment rate predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In UNRATE < 4.0 periods, SPX 60-day returns are positive in less than 40% of instances following a UNRATE decline > 0.1pp.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 2.5% signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.5.
